study: Crop-JEPA Stage B: greenness-guided target placement in I-JEPA (LUCASVision)

hypotheses.H1: veg_pos > ijepa on the primary endpoint
hypotheses.H4 (Tier 2, not in the Holm family): the veg_pos effect is smaller under SIGReg/LeJEPA than under EMA I-JEPA

primary_endpoint.evaluation: linear probe (logistic regression, C chosen on validation macro-F1) on frozen target-encoder features
primary_endpoint.aggregation: mean over the label draws of a regime, then mean over the regimes
primary_endpoint.unit_of_analysis: pretraining seed (label draws are nested within a seed)

test.name: exact Wilcoxon signed-rank on the seed-level differences (zero differences dropped, exact enumeration)

also_reported: Wilcoxon p for the other alternatives
hierarchical bootstrap CI: resample seeds -> label draws within seed -> test images (shared by arms)

decision_rules.A > B (confirmed): Holm-adjusted p (greater) < 0.05 AND 95% CI lower bound > 0
decision_rules.A < B: 95% CI upper bound < 0 (descriptive; not a pre-registered hypothesis)

interpretation_table: veg_pos beats ijepa, pos_matched and veg_neg -> greenness-guided placement helps (positive result)
veg_pos ~ pos_matched > ijepa -> the effect is a spatial prior, not greenness
veg_pos ~ ijepa ~ others (all three equivalent) -> placement does not matter at this scale (negative result)
anything else -> mixed / inconclusive (reported as such)
secondary_exploratory: tau sweep, data-size axis, LeJEPA arms (Tier 2)

gates.G0: online k-NN val F1 of the pilot >= random_init + 3.0 pp AND min RankMe >= 0.05 x enc_dim
gates.G1: interpretation table above, with the decision rules above
